verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents automatic security scans through a built-in Security tab with an out-of-the-box Snyk integration. The scanning engine is a third-party provider that must be installed, and the evidence does not say whether it covers vulnerable dependencies, code-level security issues, or both. Missing for 10: native first-party scanning, explicit documentation of dependency (SCA) versus code (SAST) coverage, details on scan triggers or results surfacing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have my repository automatically scanned for vulnerable dependencies and code security issues

citations.quote: Run automatic security scans with out-of-the-box integration with Snyk, or connect to other providers. Simply open an existing repository or create a new one and navigate to the Security tab to install the Snyk integration.
